summary: Reproduced at 08dde73e664b. A greedy job on 'The capital of France is' (control continuation ' Paris. It is the largest city in') with banned_strings=['paris'] streamed clean text (' ______.\nA. London\nB.'), but its emitted token_ids [12095, 32671, 624, 32, 13, 12095, 7148, 198, 33, 13] contain token 12095 (' Paris') twice, the same ID reported twice in suppressed_tokens: after the rewind, held_tokens was not restored (the code assigns held_token), so rejected IDs were flushed with later output while held_text was restored.
what_ran: repro.py loads Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct unquantized on physical GPU 1 with Cache (2048 tokens), Tokenizer and Generator, runs a control 8-token ArgmaxSampler job, then the same job with banned_strings=['paris'], collecting text, token_ids and suppressed_tokens from iterate().
limits: One prompt, one banned string, greedy sampling; downstream consumers of token_ids were not examined.
